release_identity.service_model: one RuinsCiv account/backend/state shared by Android and web/PWA
release_identity.wave_policy: RuinsCiv is isolated from WAVE_MAWJA source/runtime/state; only the already-authorized WIF/OIDC infrastructure mechanism may be reused.

execution_policy.rule: Each run processes as many consecutive safe, unblocked tasks as possible; never intentionally limit a run to one task.
execution_policy.publish_rule: Publish only after the corresponding real gate passes; otherwise record the exact blocker and continue with the next unblocked task.
execution_policy.authority_rule: Never downgrade to Stage15/Stage16 or superseded runtime sources. Preserve historical evidence, but remove/exclude obsolete assets and fallbacks from active runtime/export paths.
execution_policy.legacy_avatar_rule: thf_humanoid_v1..v6 are forbidden in active runtime/export output.

tasks.title: Unify website/PWA and Android on same service contract
tasks.result: The auth overlay patches both web clients and native Godot client against the same backend routes and token/account namespace.
acceptance: offline cache never forks authoritative account state

tasks.title: Web staging then production deployment and live smoke
acceptance: login and core social world smoke pass

tasks.title: Production signing and Play App Signing gate
tasks.blocker: The authorized WIF service account can build and call Android Publisher, but it lacks secretmanager.secrets.create and project get/set IAM policy. Secure RuinsCiv upload-key provisioning therefore cannot be completed with this principal yet; no key material was written to Git or logs.
